name: Grok Bot Notify
description: Hands Orca's agent alerts (done, waiting, blocked) and FullOps events for a person (decisions, ask judgments, holds, failures, escalations) to Grok Bot. The alert half of orca-helm.

settings.title: Routes (one Grok Bot per line)
settings.description: Edited from the Grok Bot panel in the right sidebar (one card per bot, workspaces as checkboxes). It stores one line per bot: name | workspaces | routine URL | Authorization; typing lines here still works. On save the Authorization value moves to encrypted secrets and the line ends in (saved).

settings.title: Grok Bot routine URL
settings.description: Only while Routes has no valid line: one routine URL that gets every workspace's alerts.

settings.title: Authorization value
settings.description: Only while Routes has no valid line: the Authorization value for the URL above. Paste it once; the worker moves it into encrypted secrets and clears this field (when secrets are unavailable, it stays here and is sent as is).

settings.title: States
settings.description: Comma-separated agent states to hand to Grok Bot: done, waiting, blocked, working.

settings.title: Reminder minutes
settings.description: A terminal's alert is sent only when its last output changes (or, when the output cannot be read, its state). Set minutes to send the same state and output once more as a reminder after they last that long; 0 (the default) never reminds, so a missed question is not asked again.

settings.title: Send FullOps auto judgments
settings.description: Also hand a bot-started task's FullOps auto judgment to Grok Bot. Decisions, ask judgments, holds, failures and escalations always go.
